title: Mike Vrabel: Drake Maye will learn from it, hopefully we'll be better for it in the end

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel: Drake Maye will learn from it, hopefully we'll be better for it in the end
sources.description: Though Patriots quarterback Drake Maye’s poor fourth quarter downed the Patriots in Wednesday’s season-opener against the Seahawks, head coach Mike Vrabel expressed confidence that the young signal-caller will be better going forward.
